name: *Efraim *Schwartz
headline: Director of Professional Services at Computer Design & Integration
about:
As a Director of Professional Services and a virtual CIO, I lead a team of Practice Managers and consultants specializing in architecture assessment, design, implementation, and optimization of distributed IT infrastructures. 
I have twenty-five years in high-tech & computer-related industries including; IT Strategy & Solutions Consulting, Service and Support of IT, project management, Computer Research and Development, Medical Information Systems, Manufacturing, and deployment of business applications that improve bottom line business results.
This unique combination of a solid technical foundation and years of business management, implementing leading edge IT projects allows me to excel in both financial and customer satisfaction results. Customers benefit form my ability to translate business needs into quantifiable IT specifications that I implements in the most cost affective way.
My project responsibilities included:
Lead Analysis and design of consolidation and business continuity project for a major financial trading institute. The project included business critical processing on 80 Unix and 90 Windows servers.
Lead, design and implement a Total Quality Management project, which lead to a 23% improvement in quality of service in the area of network implementations. This was a two-year project with over 100 engineers participating in the effort. 
Lead, design, and Implement a new partnering program, which increased his district ability to provide consulting services at a better value to the end user utilizing partners resource, resulting in 100% success rate in meeting both financial results and customer satisfaction in 54 engagements
Lead the design of a global systems monitoring solution for a Fortune 25 corporation providing a solution to Network and System management of 11 manufacturing divisions across the world 
Provided network design and implementation for a large Fortune 50 manufacturing customer on implementation of SAP r/3 solution.

Specialties: * Management of Professional Services organizations
* Mapping Business Needs to IT Solutions 
* Business Continuity Planning
* IT Consolidation
* IT Architecture Planning 
* Global Network design and implementation
* Network & System management Design & Implementation
* Operations Process Definition & Restructuring

experiences.description: Direct the operations of 4 practice managers and their consulting staff of 40.  Complete PS lifecycle management from assistance to services sales team in identifying, qualifying, and closing new services engagements, to delivery, customer satisfaction, and meeting P&L targets.

Program Manager, Business Continuity (East Business Unit, FY2002)
Right after 9/11, I was appointed as the Consulting Business Unit manager of the Emergency Response Task Force which successfully recovered all HP customers.  As a follow-up I was recruited to partner with senior managers from different business units (Sales, Services, Outsourcing, and Consulting.) across the HP organization to define, create and deliver the new business continuity (BC) program for targeted customers.  Created a unified HP business program vision, customer value proposition, solution proposals, services pricing, risk mitigation strategy, and delivery methodology. Presented proposal and received approval from senior executives.  The program took the best product offering of HP different business units and integrated them into a seamless solution that generated new revenue stream.

Directed 15 to 30 consultants and 3 managers providing business development and solution delivery in IT area.  We concentrated on networking, high availability, disaster recovery, and always on environment. I developed high level (CxO) relationships, and managed multi-million dollar engagements in the target customer base (Fortune 500).
